_about: Pass/fail thresholds for stage 8, written 2026-11-28 before run.py was first executed. All errors are measured on /odom_gt (simulator ground truth) in the start frame of the run: origin at the robot's true start pose, x forward, y left. Each check compares one key of results/<id>.json 'metrics' with max (value <= x), min (value >= x) or equals. Thresholds are not loosened to make a task pass; a changed threshold keeps its old value and the reason under 'changes'.

8.01.title: Reach a point with timed commands
8.01.basis: Baseline for 8.02. Target (1.5, 0.5) m: turn 18.4 deg at 0.4 rad/s, then 1.58 m at 0.25 m/s. Project 3 measured 0.231 m/s achieved for 0.25 commanded, which predicts about 0.12 m short; 0.30 m allows heading error on top.

8.02.title: Reach the same point with odometry feedback
8.02.basis: Project 4 goal 1 (2 m ahead): 0.046 m true error; the follower stops at 0.02 m on /odom, and /odom drifted up to 0.05 m in project 3 runs.

8.03.title: Reach a target orientation
8.03.basis: Three turns on the spot to +90, -90 and 0 deg. Turn tolerance 2 deg on /odom; /odom yaw drift was up to 4.1 deg over a 52 s run in project 3.

8.04.title: Reach a target pose
8.04.basis: Goal (1.5, 0.5, 90 deg) with project 4's polar controller and default gains. Project 4 goals 1 and 2: 0.046 and 0.087 m, -0.5 and -3.4 deg true.

8.05.title: Walk a straight line
8.05.basis: 2.5 m along x with the carrot follower (lookahead 0.4 m). Project 3 closed-loop square sides: corner errors 0.01 to 0.05 m.

8.06.title: Walk a square
8.06.basis: 1.5 m square, stop at each corner. Project 3 closed loop: 0.01, 0.01, 0.05, 0.02 m.

8.07.title: Walk a circle
8.07.basis: Radius 0.6 m at 0.18 m/s, feedforward w = v / r plus feedback on radial and heading error (motion.Circle; on a perfect robot it stays within 0.005 m). Project 3 figure-eight lobes (r = 0.45 m, carrot follower): crossing error 0.07 m, final 0.05 m.

8.08.title: Walk a figure-eight
8.08.basis: Project 3 figure-eight closed loop, same points and gains: crossing 0.07 m, final 0.05 m.

8.09.title: Follow waypoints
8.09.basis: Five waypoints with a stop at each, the last one the start. Same follower as 8.06.

8.10.title: Correct after a disturbance
8.10.basis: 3 m line at 0.25 m/s; a lateral push through /apply_link_wrench on base_link (force and duration in params/push.yaml) 1.0 m along the line. The push counts only if it moves the trunk at least 0.10 m off the line. Recovery: back within 0.05 m of the line. The same push under timed commands must leave at least 0.10 m, or the comparison shows nothing.

8.11.title: Return to the start
8.11.basis: Polar controller out to (2.0, 1.0, 180 deg) and back to (0, 0, 0). Project 4 goal 5 (back at start after 10.7 m): 0.081 m, -5.4 deg true.
